notes: Session data has a new Leftovers tab: it finds the build output, dependency folders, scratch directories and checkpoints that Claude Code and Codex sessions leave behind, and can slim the screenshots out of old transcripts — the conversation stays, the wasted space goes.

Disk cleanup can free space on its own: when a drive drops to a share you set (5% by default), Stacker clears rebuildable build output, package caches and week-old temporary files step by step until the drive has room again. It is on but can be switched off, and every run is kept in a history.

The API service and its log are gone, along with the local-model AI option: driving a subscription CLI from another program breaks the vendors' terms, so Stacker's AI now uses only an external API with your own key.

Agent install and update are steadier: the home page and the install page share one scan, npm 11 runs an agent package's own install script, an uninstalled program's leftover entry no longer counts as installed, the Antigravity CLI updates for real, and a download a scanner is still holding is waited for.
The Python source speed test says why a source failed and checks both of its paths at once, with an Aliyun fallback for pyenv-win; pyenv's own files are read instead of running it.
Version lists, update checks and downloads all go through Stacker's own proxy.
The vault can switch to another vault file, the Backups page wording is fixed, and the home page's disk card shows as many disks as it has room for.
